articles.title: Irankrieg: Ölpreis steigt um weitere 20 Prozent auf mehr als 110 US-Dollar
articles.teaser: Erstmals seit 2022 kostet ein Fass Rohöl mehr als 100 Dollar. Die Aktienmärkte brechen ein. Donald Trump spricht von einem "kleinen Preis" für Sicherheit und Frieden.
articles.image_title: Irankrieg: HOUSTON, TEXAS - JUNE 18: In an aerial view, oil storage containers are seen near the LyondellBasell Houston refinery at sunset on June 18, 2025 in Houston, Texas. Oil prices have spiked over concerns that the Israel and Iran war could lead into a broader conflict involving the United States. Israel, in its largest attack to date against Iran, has targeted several gas and oil depots including striking Tehran’s main gas depot and its central oil refinery according to a report from Iran’s oil ministry. (Photo by Brandon Bell/Getty Images)

articles.teaser: Als Teil milliardenschwerer Investitionen hat Google in Berlin ein KI-Zentrum eröffnet. Digitalminister Wildberger sieht darin keine Gefahr für die digitale Souveränität.
articles.image_title: Künstliche Intelligenz: A man walks during the opening of a Google AI-Centre in Berlin on March 5, 2026. Google opens an AI centre in Berlin, the latest sign of Europe's deepening reliance on US firms in cutting edge technologies despite the continent's stated aim to catch up with its rivals. Germany's ministry for digital affairs told AFP the centre will bring together cloud computing and data infrastructure, "AI development" operations as well as a space for cooperation between start-ups and research centres. (Photo by Tobias SCHWARZ / AFP via Getty Images)
